notes: dataset_dir -> data/multitask_bloom_rewrite_separate_eduguard_v3_3: owner-built lecture summarization replaces the previous summarization task.

validation/test limits equal the dataset counts; summarization max_new_tokens covers the longest summary with 25% headroom (when --check-tokens ran). Model, LoRA, optimizer, epochs and task weights unchanged.

2026-11-26 speed: token_budget_batching packs similar-length rows under a budget equal to the longest train row (no truncation; max_seq_length unchanged); gradient accumulation is derived so ~16 examples per optimizer step are kept. mixed_precision bf16 (Qwen2.5 native) replaces fp16. attn_implementation stays sdpa (fused attention, faster than eager).

2026-11-26 memory: assistant_logits_only computes LM-head logits only from the first answer token (logits_to_keep); identical loss, removes the ~4.4 GB fp32 full-prompt logits that overflowed VRAM into Windows shared memory.

2026-11-26 memory: cuda_memory_fraction 0.8 (~12.8 GB of 16 GB) caps the PyTorch allocator below physical VRAM so Windows sysmem fallback never engages; the max-length preflight runs under the same cap.

2026-11-26 attention: sdpa_repeat_kv_for_gqa repeats Qwen2.5 KV heads before SDPA. This torch build has no flash attention, so enable_gqa fell back to the O(L^2) math kernel (7,217-token row: 10.3 GB activations, 7.3 s fwd+bwd); with repeat_kv the memory-efficient kernel runs (2.2 GB, 2.4 s). Same math transformers uses whenever a mask is present.

2026-11-26 memory: chunked_supervised_loss applies the LM head + cross-entropy only to answer tokens in checkpointed 1,024-token chunks (same loss: token sum / num_items_in_batch). Fixes an OOM at step 210 where a multi-row batch still needed 3.2 GB of fp32 logits under assistant_logits_only. The GPU preflight now also backpropagates the worst multi-row batches of the epoch plan.
